d:
The Pistons defeated the Hornets, 97-89 tonight in Detroit. Cade Cunningham finished with a team-high 30 points along with 7 assists and 5 rebounds for the Pistons, while Paul Reed tallied 16 points, 4 rebounds and 3 steals in the game. Brandon Miller recorded 31 points, 12 rebounds and 3 assists. The Pistons improve their record to 4-1 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-2 for the season.
